name: Justice Democrats
subject: Chuck Schumer is out of touch
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Yesterday, Senate Democrats voted on sending more bombs and bulldozers to
Israel.

Bernie Sanders introduced two motions to block these weapons transfers. 80
percent of the caucus — more Democrats than ever before — joined him.

The tide is turning, but it still wasn’t enough. A small group of
war-mongering Democrats — including Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer —
joined Republicans to stop these motions and approve the sale of both
bulldozers and 1000-lb bombs.

Once again, Sen. Schumer shamefully voted on behalf of his AIPAC donors
and Israel’s government instead of the American people.

One of our top party leaders would rather give a genocidal state more
resources to illegally destroy Palestinian and Lebanese villages than
listen to the vast majority of Democratic voters who oppose our tax
dollars being used to conduct ethnic cleansing.

Rep. Ro Khanna had a message for Schumer after these votes:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20260416-schumer-step-aside/?source=em20260416-37673&t=1002&akid=37673%2E1203867%2Egut5G5 ]Tweet from @RoKhanna: 'Chuck Schumer was one of 7 Senate Democrats to
vote to send bulldozers to Israel. 40 Democratic Senators voted no. Mr.
Schumer, you are out of touch with our base and the nation. Step aside.'

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20260416-schumer-step-aside/?source=em20260416-37673&t=1003&akid=37673%2E1203867%2Egut5G5 ]If you agree with us and Ro and believe it’s time for Schumer to step
down as Minority Leader, add your name to our petition and build the
pressure now!

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Our campaign to register new voters -- along with turning out all these voters -- are the two most important things we're doing between now and November.
Vote-suppressing state legislatures are gearing up to pass more restrictive laws. Congress is paralyzed and beholden to the president. Beating our voter registration goal -- again -- to register new voters might be our best hope to turn the tide so we can protect and expand our right to vote.
The math is simple: Every $3 can help register a new voter. Can we count on you to chip in $36 and help register 12 new voters, Team? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=041626_3&amount=36]

Voter registration is the quickest response to voter suppression legislation. Opponents of voting rights have seen how pro-democracy groups like ours have mobilized new voters in the face of suppression, so they're now targeting the work of pro-voting groups to stop our ability to register new voters.

body:
Hi there,
After serving our country for 35 years in the Navy, I was removed from my position by Pete Hegseth without reason.
I spent my entire life in service to this country, always putting the mission and the people above myself. But when I was forced out, I had a choice: go out quietly, or find a way to keep serving.
I’ve always lived by three simple ideals: honor, integrity, and respect. That’s why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s first district. If you believe that’s what we need in Washington right now, please consider splitting $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
The day I was removed from my position, I was forced to leave behind my life’s work. I never went back to the Pentagon or wore the uniform again.
But this story isn’t just about me. Throughout the first year of Donald Trump’s second term, every woman serving as a three or four-star admiral in the Navy has been fired, forced out, or reassigned. This wasn’t an isolated incident. It’s a pattern.
When leadership decisions are driven by politics instead of integrity, our families, communities, and nation pay the price.
That’s why I’m running for Congress: to keep serving, to stand up when it’s hardest, and to fight for leadership that puts country over politics every time.
Early support in races like this matters most. We have a long road ahead of us if we’re going to fill this open seat and make the government work for the people again. If you can, please split $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to help me hit the ground running and prove that service to our country shouldn’t end just because someone in power says it should. This week, [EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin](https://substack.com/redirect/0745b698-ef8d-463e-9598-54b408a6f998?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Interior Secretary Doug Burgum](https://substack.com/redirect/0745b698-ef8d-463e-9598-54b408a6f998?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Energy Secretary Chris Wright](https://substack.com/redirect/0745b698-ef8d-463e-9598-54b408a6f998?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) broke ground on the [Northeast Supply Enhancement (NESE) pipeline](https://substack.com/redirect/0745b698-ef8d-463e-9598-54b408a6f998?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in New York City. EPA says the project will transport natural gas from Pennsylvania into New York City and Long Island, add 400,000 dekatherms per day of capacity, serve the equivalent of 2.3 million homes, and remain on track to enter service in Q4 2027.
That is real progress for New York.
But Connecticut should not kid itself.
Connecticut is still iced out.
The fact that a pipeline can now reach New York does not mean New England's broader supply problem has been solved. In fact, EPA itself said that ["up next on the priority list" is getting the Constitution Pipeline approved](https://substack.com/redirect/0745b698-ef8d-463e-9598-54b408a6f998?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) so New England residents can tap the same resources, especially during cold winter months.
**Where Is the Rub?**
This is the part too many people miss because they do not understand the jurisdictional maze of state and federal law: the main blocker is not a lack of federal pipeline authority in the abstract. The blocker is the environmental permitting structure, especially [Section 401 of the Clean Water Act](https://substack.com/redirect/5cad8b0b-04c6-4a60-9b34-f9542005ddac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). EPA's own overview says that states and authorized Tribes have authority to grant, deny, or waive certification for proposed federal licenses or permits that may discharge into waters of the United States, and that certification is required before a federal agency issues such a permit or license.
That means the federal government can approve an interstate pipeline, and a state can still stop it. Under the statute itself, the controlling provision is [33 U.S.C. § 1341](https://substack.com/redirect/5cb79cf0-d2f9-488f-9d68-f203d92facd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That is not rhetoric. That is case law. And that is what keeps happening to the Constitution State.
In [Constitution Pipeline Co. v. New York State Department of Environmental Conservation](https://substack.com/redirect/e243600f-a213-46c6-b4cc-f556dfd69e22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Second Circuit upheld New York's denial of the project's Section 401 certification. The court described the petition as a challenge to NYSDEC's denial of certification and denied the petition for review, leaving New York's action in place.
The deeper legal foundation came earlier in [PUD No. 1 of Jefferson County v. Washington Department of Ecology, 511 U.S. 700 (1994)](https://substack.com/redirect/88238bbf-e1e1-499a-b83f-b67e99db5a78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where the Supreme Court held that states may impose conditions under Section 401 to assure compliance with state water quality standards and other appropriate requirements of state law. In plain English, the Court recognized that Section 401 is not a paperwork exercise. It is real state power.
**Local Environmental Law Is the Challenge**
So when people say Washington should just bulldoze past Albany and invoke some vague federal power, they are skipping the central legal fact: under current law, there is no simple automatic override that wipes away a state's Section 401 role for interstate gas pipelines. EPA's [January 13, 2026 proposal to revise the Section 401 regulations](https://substack.com/redirect/ce7bfe18-922d-46ee-b1f8-f40cc8d789a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) shows that the administration understands the problem, but streamlining is not the same as eliminating the state certification choke point.
That is why this New York groundbreaking cuts both ways.
It is good news because it shows the federal government is again serious about pipeline expansion, reliability, and affordability in the Northeast. It is frustrating news because it also proves the political system can move infrastructure when it wants to, yet Connecticut and the rest of New England remain trapped behind a legal structure that still allows one state to function as the regional gatekeeper.
Lee Zeldin matters here for exactly that reason. As the current EPA Administrator, he is now publicly tying pipeline expansion to affordability and reliability in the Northeast. But that does not mean he can wave away Section 401. He cannot.
The hard truth is this: the blocker is not "nature." The blocker is the environmental review and certification regime that lets states use water-quality authority to stop federally approved interstate gas projects. Until Congress narrows that power, rebalances it, or creates a stronger federal override for interstate gas infrastructure, Connecticut's energy future can still be decided outside Connecticut. That conclusion follows from the statute, the EPA's own explanation of Section 401, and the governing case law.
**The Hard Truth**
New York can get energy.
Connecticut cannot--unless New York allows it.
That is not a conspiracy.
That is the current legal structure.
**The Big Lies You 're Hearing**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6c893896-a791-4a83-8f49-74a946cdc1e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Some are now claiming:
_" Just use the Defense Production Act or federal law to bypass New York."_
That sounds good.
It is wrong.
**Why There Is No Easy Federal Override?**
The [Defense Production Act of 1950](https://substack.com/redirect/4aeb8632-029a-4dde-b125-3e72345cbec0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) can accelerate production priorities and materials allocation, but nothing in the sources above suggests it displaces Clean Water Act permitting or nullifies Section 401 certification requirements for pipeline construction. By contrast, the law actually governing this fight is [Clean Water Act Section 401](https://substack.com/redirect/5cad8b0b-04c6-4a60-9b34-f9542005ddac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So at most, the DPA could help with production or supply chain issues; it does not solve the permitting veto point. This is a legal inference from the governing statutory framework, not an express EPA holding.
_What about "just use Section 216 of the Federal Power Act"?_
That argument fails for a simpler reason: [Section 216 of the Federal Power Act](https://substack.com/redirect/de68ca23-802a-4335-8382-346933aee48e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) concerns federal siting authority for certain electric transmission facilities, not interstate natural gas pipelines. So whatever one thinks of Section 216, it is not a pipeline workaround.
Read that again:
The federal government can override states for some power lines--
but not for the fuel that powers them.
New York is breaking ground.
Connecticut is still waiting.

body:
We need your help to spread Roy’s message far and wide.
| | | | | [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9295?source=&t=6&akid=1056%2E124072%2E8nEgPE)
---
Peter, Just last week, we had a huge campaign rally in Durham, and the energy on the ground was great! Hundreds of folks came together to hear Roy speak about what we need to do in order to win this race, flip North Carolina blue and make stuff cost less.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9296?t=7&akid=1056%2E124072%2E8nEgPE)
But here’s the deal: rallies like this take a lot of resources. Printing signs, making calls and sending texts to recruit volunteers, making sure we have things like water and food for attendees – all of these things are necessary to effectively connect with the voters, and that means we need to raise the funds to pay for them.
**We’re going to continue traveling across the state – holding more rallies, knocking on doors, meeting more voters – but we need your help to make it happen. Every time you pitch in to our grassroots campaign, you can know that your donation goes directly toward connecting with North Carolinians and flipping this seat blue.**
**[That’s why we’re asking: Will you chip in $5 or more today to fuel our fight to win in North Carolina and send Roy Cooper to the U.S. Senate? Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

Peter,
Julio Salinas’ runoff on **May 26** is coming up fast.
**We have a real shot at victory in the Rio Grande Valley, but we have to give it everything we’ve got.**
Back in March, Julio came out on top in a three-way primary, leading the field by just shy of **200 votes.** Now he’s headed into a runoff on **May 26** against Seby Haddad, a conservative Democrat who has spent his career voting Republican, backing the same politicians that have held the Valley back for decades, and to this day attends Tea Party meetings.
It’s not an exaggeration to say that if Julio doesn’t win this runoff, Texas Republicans might as well have won this seat despite it being in a safe blue district. That’s why this race matters so much.
There is a real chance that even if Democrats end up winning a majority in the state house in the coming years, Julio's opponent could be the reason they would only have the majority on paper, but not in reality.
Not only that, but Julio’s March advancement makes it clear that voters in the Valley are ready for a leader who will actually represent their values and fight for them, not just talk about it.
**Julio is that leader.** He grew up in the Valley and has the experience of being a staffer in the state legislature, so he knows exactly what to do when he gets there. He’ll fight to expand Medicaid, give teachers a $15,000 raise, establish paid family leave, and cap prescription drug prices. He’s seen firsthand what it looks like when working families in the Rio Grande Valley can’t afford insulin or keep up with rising costs on low wages — it’s those experiences that fuel his fight.
District 41 is heavily Democratic, so this runoff is critical. **May 26** decides the future of this seat, and Julio needs grassroots supporters like you showing up for him right now so he can beat back his D.I.N.O. Democrat In Name Only opponent and win this.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: The Pope Sounds Like a Politician. Homan Just Proved It.
body:
Plus: Trump's approval just collapsed 34 points with his base — here's what it means for NM | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=7ac28baff9&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
David Axelrod — Obama's chief strategist, not even a Catholic — got a private audience with Pope Leo last week.[ Days later, three Cardinals lined up on 60 Minutes to lay into Trump.](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=61f5845816&e=567664f14c) Then Archbishop Wester piled on in the Albuquerque Journal.

Plus, the NM governor's race finance reports dropped. What's on Bregman's donor list should end his campaign.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=7dc554108c&e=567664f14c)
| |
🔥 **AXELROD MEETS POPE LEO — THEN THE CARDINALS LINE UP ON 60 MINUTES
**
Cardinal Cupich went on national television and sounded like he was reading DNC talking points. We play the clip. You tell us if that sounds like a church leader or a political operative.

Then JD Vance and Tom Homan — both Catholics — responded. What Homan said about a 9-year-old trafficking victim will stop you cold.

When you hear what the Pope won't say about 100,000 Christians in Nigeria — and what Archbishop Wester told NM priests they couldn't say from the pulpit — the double standard is staggering.

🚨 **ARCHBISHOP WESTER GOES AFTER TRUMP — MARK REVEALS WHAT HE DID IN 2022
**
Wester called Trump's response a "political cudgel" in the Albuquerque Journal. Bold words from a man who gave NM priests a very specific directive in 2022.Mark tells the story of the priest who said it to his face. The issue they were told not to discuss. The election it could have changed. You need to hear this one for yourself.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=9081cf50d4&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
💰 **NM GOVERNOR'S RACE — THE MONEY JUST DROPPED**
Campaign finance reports are in. One Democrat has burned through a staggering amount of cash before the primary even started. The other took money from donors who are toxic in a Democratic primary — and Jay McCluskey explains why it's a death sentence.
On the Republican side, one candidate self-funded his whole campaign. His biggest outside donor isn't even from New Mexico.
Jay breaks down who's in trouble, who can still win, and what the next four weeks look like.

📉 **ONE NUMBER EVERY NM REPUBLICAN NEEDS TO SEE**
Harry Enten pulled up Trump's approval with the voters who put him in office. The shift is a 34-point swing — and every Republican running for governor in this state is about to feel it.
---

In 2018, President Trump appointed me as White House Fellow. I advised his administration on tackling opioids, rescuing prisoners of war, and leading counterterrorism efforts. If you would like to get fewer emails, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59469?t=1&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ) If you would like to unsubscribe, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59470?t=2&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ) [**Hey → We’re inviting Top Democrats across the country to participate in our Joe Biden Legacy Survey, reflecting on his achievements, leadership, and impact on the nation!**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73724?t=3&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ) [](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73724?t=4&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ) [ **Team: Please begin your Joe Biden Legacy survey now to represent Democrats in your city →**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73724?t=5&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ) | [BEGIN MY JOE BIDEN LEGACY SURVEY →](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73724?t=6&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ)
---
[ ****1,099 more local responses needed before 11:59 PM to validate our Democratic data ****](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73724?t=7&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ)
Team, President Joe Biden showed us what a TRUE leader looks like.

Remember, during his time as President, Joe Biden:

\- **ADVANCED** voting rights legislation,
\- **NOMINATED** the first Black woman to the Supreme Court,
\- **HELPED** our country recover and rebuild after the COVID-19 pandemic and
\- **WORKED** to restore stability and integrity to the White House.

_And that’s just to name a few of his accomplishments!!_

As we honor his legacy, we’re gathering nationwide feedback on how Americans view the progress made during his administration.

Please – your input will help us understand how Democrats in your city feel about President Joe Biden’s accomplishments and legacy.
[ **Please, begin your President Joe Biden Legacy Survey to represent Top Democrats in your city! Your response is absolutely crucial to validating our local data → →**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73724?t=8&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ)
[BEGIN MY JOE BIDEN LEGACY SURVEY →](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73724?t=9&akid=24136%2E4449941%2EK6k0LZ)
---
Thank you,

Fight For Reform

When there's no incumbent on the ballot, they don't turn into landslides - They turn into political wars.

_**[In 2025, Democrats raised $1.8 Billion via ActBlue, and there's no question that they'll top that this year!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdv78gcb0srs95tsl0pb11v3rsebmk7numpq3bhg_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c5h6eoj2c1h2bs "In 2025, Democrats raised $1.8 Billion via ActBlue, and there’s no question that they’ll top that this year!")**_

It steers the national conversation against President Trump and all of MAGA.

Lose just one race you're supposed to win, and suddenly the Fake News starts jawing about MAGA being on its last legs.

**And the Democrats know how to keep the narrative alive for as long as humanly possible.**

With you by my side, we won't be intimidated or let it get to that point. If you're able, I'm humbly asking you to chip in today to help me deliver a CRUCIAL victory for MAGA.

**It 's bigger, higher profile, and President Trump's home state.**

If Democrats ever manage to flip our Governor's Mansion, they'll declare the entire MAGA Movement DEAD and BURIED!

The truth is, they know they can't win in a fair fight.

That's why they've called upon their liberal media allies to launch MASSIVE smear campaigns against me, my family, and my closest friends.

All just to distract people from their so far left agenda that failed America when Joe Biden was President.

And as America's freest state, Florida needs to continue to be a vanguard for the other 49 states to follow.

**We have an uphill battle ahead, but I know you 're up for the challenge.**

With you by my side, we will deliver ANOTHER victory for MAGA.

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | A few people are collecting government checks that have nothing to do with taxes or Social Security. | No applications. ## Israel, Lebanon Agree to 10-Day Ceasefire
The leaders of Israel and Lebanon [agreed to a 10-day ceasefire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9utDAQBPCnMZ1P6z9grnDxNXT3tSnRAutjI2Mj49yJt48uifICqUea0W_ebuMNOXK6_8eNfA15TPQ8ItVKZeSjIMVIE6acZsKDAhfasIwadCfBSuXGBTmeo20WH4g0mYa8cq6zGsy1bVY_tZPqYAmA0HYwa2f73ujeKaPaQD017F9tYJVTAJ3RF3edWiAIxk0T4lUJC7RwzeXynjnVlUI884PKZc5bE_1a634I80_oQeihrrRyjK9M6GHPkedT6IFTpZKwck4YhR7a3thWg_wmyh-jVCAXPOWvVdbyse2SCyY55xQiz1XooSl-2Z8cIx-dExbuG_LXZFP_9OHD688AAAD__2NlhbY) after officials from the two countries met in Washington, President Trump said Thursday. The truce went into effect at 5 p.m. ET Thursday. In a follow-up, Trump added that [he will be inviting](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdEb22odD4SIN3aVNidawPjYy5mScQ_f3EUmUH0g30khv9Ob9Ol6RE-fbG67ka9zGTMeeqFYqI-8FKSUKmLc8Ee4UudCKZQQFnVRWajfOyOk52mb2kQjINOS1c50FZfpLs3gbwPZRgw5zdBdlphe0EfregOk6gtiwP2nKaqeV6gy0rg8XRSoaFwJir4VVNHPdSvuxca4LxfTcHlTaaVub5Jda77swrwIGAcNxHO2Uw3SWAoYTLWBQVsCgz1TL53qXP2byV03-uUkumOWBpV3qmpri5_vBKfHeOWHVbUVO36v1X1c9PHwFAAD__zk9fAU) Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and President Joseph Aoun of Lebanon to the White House "for the first meaningful talks between Israel and Lebanon since 1983, a very long time ago." The pause in Israel's nearly seven-week campaign against Hezbollah could unlock stalled US-Iran peace talks. Tehran had demanded an end to Israeli strikes in Lebanon as a precondition for any deal ending Operation Epic Fury. Meanwhile, the US blockade of Iranian ports remains in full effect. Central Command said 13 vessels have been turned away, and Secretary of War Pete Hegseth warned Iran's new regime to "choose wisely" on reaching a deal.
## GOP Finalizing National Privacy Bill
A House GOP working group led by Energy and Commerce leaders is [finalizing a draft national privacy bill](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAQRb8Gd6ww2OZt4WKjyErz0qRIaY3NsDsRBgSzizZfHzm_8LorXeno3vP7c_0EChTvP-HAmX1aI7YakBnLSrUAhoAbxBR3hIqeCh5QVq30JNUge7s6oPBeh87NHlGj6XDurZ0Grcx17B4zbErvOLrRu2Ece2u8UuPHDn74wKvFvqP5pKmht71Sk9EXe91Ghcobu20A114MCh1xKpc_iSI_0Id3emG57OnowvxgzlWYm9CL0Etr7XLUeHZCLxjlswq9nKeEXnIKxLSf8Z6y9BQh0F-Kd-kKeJYRmFKEIHOhF-xvGaBJfgDLlp7ByVwQj8yyMjCeFCjydtO9oemHMEvayQnz_dupE1v9hSV3ZXa5UQhUJysGdT-Awv_h_CXbr1n_CwAA__8vMpYT) that would override state privacy statutes and sharply limit individuals' ability to sue companies, while a Democratic-sponsored alternative quietly moves through committee. The draft would preempt roughly 20 existing state laws, according to a source. The draft would not allow individuals to sue companies for violating their privacy rights, potentially limiting enforcement to government regulators such as state attorneys general or the Federal Trade Commission. Democrats are opposed to that national plan, instead supporting a framework that allows people to bring individual lawsuits against companies and that allows states to implement tougher standards. Separately, Rep. Zoe Lofgren (D-Calif.) introduced H.R. 8014, the "Online Privacy Act of 2026," on March 19. The bill would [create a new Digital Privacy Agency](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAcBPCn0Y4NICufBcXX2O21V5o_MqxcEAyyGt_-svsK1_4ymUzm-zE9KMSQnl-0wlSfp4Rzj6gVZQp7IcQISymnGbTDh4KVyiS57BlXTOjJUYjXpFpnPCDRtTBC615J3g33djEgDau9U52FH7xV5CHuwgro7h_nvg3m3caV0ILzvpM3Pdg7B_edtpZoEI3icKHmcvvJIdUFPl75QLnNeW2jWWrd9qb738ixkWOiGuksOALOd6CRI5Ua5ohGjo4qsa2Eg-aLvTZHFczDoVBkNsTIQqolu9cMZ1-VnR-q7JkZpetcUNAW47a3h73XjeLPlUL8DKl_eu8w8jcAAP__ag-H0A) to enforce them. It has no bipartisan support so far.
## Tom Cruise to Return in New _Top Gun_ Sequel
Paramount Pictures officially confirmed Thursday that [_Top Gun 3_ is in active development](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO3CAUBODT4I4VYAzZgiKNuz9tSgvDw34JBgverrO3j5wrpBtppE-j-fm1fHnMWLYf_gBHqS4Frp6BCNqCvXnIGVZfagngOyRscPi2KKEMF5pLu0SP-bPoIboEoGAcwElrjVZifE7D7owMU7Q-BhODUVLoIHX8NqooTBJmCgO6WxNaWimEGdXDPtdJgEijXVfvn5JpARGptsevioV2SPlT39AeoR5DdjvR2dn4namZqfn0G3T8c3dMzbfM1Cw0U7O8ExSCRh7LAYWYmqmefHsVPvKaEgb0OX84Fn7V9rvzC2nnVA8e2gs78Ab0agXLxtQ8NBfPC3PGbizTYjs85n-T6L9-fDv1NwAA__9SwIbm), with Tom Cruise returning as Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and Jerry Bruckheimer reprising his producing role. The sequel follows 2022's blockbuster _Top Gun: Maverick,_ which [grossed roughly $1.5 billion globally](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ8Gd0SwEBMKir9xl7-90lrbS7J32OSAOMrbn3yvcOVopG8038d1vCIn3m7_caXQYh43etVErVEZuRaklGjCLW8zYaXIhVYsIyjopbJSu3FBTu_RdkuIRECmo6Cd6y0o48_dPcwzOhcRHPSe4OJ7mhDALtrZC_poOw4HTVnttFK9gZPz01mRisZNE6LXwipauOVy-sy8tTvF9M47ldOc1y6Fe2uPKsw_AYOAYcfC1N5HJ2A4yAKGyOlIxzUBQ8sPeXtu0siWVzmXJ1eSK-5UeP6Slb6flKQG0zswZ-0FDF0Jy-PFKXHtnbDqtiKn3_n2J2d7gJ8AAAD__9G_flo) and was widely credited with reviving theatrical moviegoing after the pandemic. It earned six Oscar nominations, winning for Best Sound. Paramount film co-heads Josh Greenstein and Dana Goldberg revealed that a script by Ehren Kruger, who co-wrote _Maverick_ , is well underway. No director has been attached, and a release date has not been set.

The draft would not allow individuals to sue companies for violating their privacy rights, potentially limiting enforcement to government regulators such as state attorneys general or the Federal Trade Commission. ## Allen West Resigns as Dallas County GOP Chair
Dallas County GOP chair Allen West [resigned](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-SsyAUxZ9GOxxAIrGg-Bq7fO2Wzg1cldkbyMBNjG-_477Cdqc4c_78vm7zDSLFtP6HBzr-LHlOuFdCZizzPR9LiZhCeaWa31iAGfw3lllLPQhphLJzgEjHbNrg7jKMqkWnrB2M7u3Qt5sbUcPVqgsiYFC2l3qUAwxWLig9XqCN7gyTRlmlpDZ912uPgOMV7Rj8YsbGSAyRc-l4Q8YP1IWOc03n86MltzE_a9P_a_TU6Gnf927JH3PeOA2Nnk7Z6IlY-EwCiDCJHSuLgjWuqQq_QSwiABFU4fMr8SHW_GyLC889EsU62MbI9QGRfkv5b6jeTv8EAAD__3HRgI4) Wednesday ahead of a potential vote to remove him over his decision to revert to countywide voting for the May 26 runoff election. After precinct voting caused widespread confusion during the March 3 primary, West [amended](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3DAMRL_G7rSQKK0pFyrSuLu0KQ1aoneJaG1DUs63fx84VfrrCM5g8GZ-fcwfJFm2x096cWhf6z5vfNbMrXGZl_29FuEtlT9b3T-5UGsUf3OZQcOgtFMG50SS37PrU1h0Gk3PwSAODiwOtn8GRLpb7--wJIvO8xBHdAxm0WZB56CXcIVpZ9AYDc7eLEQmHj3jmOLqxs5pTtL2cmtPbvxFdc3vi-YW91efw7O1o3b2RwdTB9N5nrdzJbrEDiYqTWLmDqarVwfTsWdpEq9TtiqJ1X-fRDlTVY_9UPFJUhTlzJs6uTZVuMpju1zgUSHj4qN1irQm5SxpNUZGBcD3gRePqH1fQjpOyVnqgJ3TjxdJ_gfdvjf1Z4C_AQAA___vD5Go) the party's election contract to return to countywide voting for the runoff, explaining he wanted to avoid potential litigation alleging "willful and intentional voter disenfranchisement." The move [angered](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOszAQhZ8GOpBvsaFw8Td0-dst0WAPwdoBR2YSwtuv2FfY7khHOpfv6z7eIVHaHv9hRc-fOY8bHjshM5ZxyudcEm6xvLY9v7EAM4RvLKMSyjbCNNKNERKdo6mjn0TsZY1eOmeN0s7qevER7HSLYZrtzUlt3Gx16G6xC8ZMk7JdnfwVJox0UgpldKtVQMC-Q9fHMJu-MgJj4lxaXpDxA_tM57WmDXmtyS_Mz73S_yo1VGo4jqM9Ycn5cis1XHcqNUDhFAgvGYEI9ibk18Zn88jPJiyQSgNEuDVKS2c643S78Ep18fF5JKK0W1cZ8Vgh0W8v_43W26ufAAAA__9IMn_K) local activists, who criticized West for not consulting the party's executive committee before amending the contract. West initially resisted calls to reverse course and step down, but he scheduled a vote on his fate for next week's executive committee meeting. West said agreeing to the demands of his detractors would "expose the organization to potential harm" and "violate every leadership principle that I know." In a statement, the party [thanked](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u3SAUhFeDO64AE2MKijTuXtqUFj_HNgoGC867XO8-craQbqSRZr6Z31_rl40p5v2XPcHgZytrht4SIEJdXbm3GiGH-p1beUO1iNb_gboKJibKJOVqDTame5VDMI4FzQcwXKlJilFN43CY2UnrnZNhmtTmg5640360bNZyFlq5IZonjEmuOGdCjq9ReLCgZ1A6-E1qIhmEiKW-8ACEj21buh-aly_nkMyBeDUy_iRiIWLpvb-y82Hrj03E8uwhYrlKihj9I4NNyTbqy3fGm-7lov6wsVKbEmTaoSFtCFejofRM7RkDfReMeae-ZKxPdbuJWCTjbJ5_ELEM1YSrx5RimxSRbD9tTP_w8P9OfRvxNwAA__-Hw46o) West for his "exemplary leadership, steadfast dedication, and unwavering commitment to election integrity and security."
## Boyfriend Runs Over Girlfriend's Attacker
A 19-year-old woman was shot at her east Houston home Tuesday night after returning from church, and her boyfriend [used his car](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2S3CAQhU-DMqZQw0g7gQInZOvUoYqf1kANgilorVa3d-HAF9i8-733fX8-108TU8zP32bHhb63smY8W0IirKst11YjZl-P3MoXVkNk3AvrCgImLhQf59WbmK5VDX6xwj_GAZdxnicFcp7kEBa5KWmFQgBx91JZNcm7mTdh8QOVtWaISw8TapzHUYCSNwkODT4-cH54t6kHUwJ9pFJvFJDw27QtXX3NzZV9SEsgejcmfzHQDPR5njeXontBKEejkvsVA92xGOhUnEkMdO9koIVioMd7_yu7ybyFQtxe3KSET_S8kUkvrLwc1KJHnkulwIOpNTbuypHp4qHsyNvR3uiI1yPzvq2H_NfHQA918e8zphTbNDMlnruJ6R8A_Uz71wJ_AwAA__8A95ov) to run over her alleged attacker. Emanuel Marin, 24, was arrested at the scene and transported to a hospital for treatment of a broken leg. The woman is recovering from a gunshot wound to her arm. Marin previously attended the church where the woman's father is the pastor, but he was asked to stop coming about a month ago due to "unacceptable" behavior. He allegedly [confronted](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2K6zAUBOCnkbsY_cXHLlQE7g1skS222dIo1lEsolhBOrHit1-8r7DtDHwM830ZLzbEsNw-7QMNvX0aF6wlIhHm8Zo2nwMuLr-WklbMlshOd8yj5LI7cH0QMDob4jbqxpkrd4No0AiATksFnWpm448ge8WxV9CjBz0JPErggz4iqJ7rJpgd41qAEFxq1So5ocWhRxjc5PXANEcXKOWWZiR82-Ljtq9pp_RoopmJnoWpE5NnJs-11nZLL3pdce_3xNI0M3Vemfr3_-v-IWs52ZiabNyzhhhD6YBpfnvYEH9J-tsRq5E_AQAA___cY3H5) the woman after Tuesday night's service and shot her as she tried to get away. Marin has been [charged](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ugzAURp8GNiP_FerBQxe2dO2IbuwLtmJwZN-E8PYVVdUX6H706Zzv6zJdIKa4LZ-woqXXnKcN95qQCMt0zcdcIm6-PLaan1iACNwNyyS57BnXTAyTh5iOSbfeXrk3okUrhqHXUg29aoM1rufglH4zUvQKzeydMQKUEXBF4L6N9hzjWgxCcKlVp6RDQPOOg_Fu1qbRHH2kXDoKSPiCOqfjtOlcXttkA9G9NuqjkWMjx33fuzm_ZB_yo1LeTqiR41nVyDFAoT26GysZPKshZ4rbwv5C2VnKznG2wsb2kE-IWIiVLbGkXwoeFHKJFLGyCkdbrL_vMaVY-6HRfFkhph87-t-nTyu_AwAA__8C05Do) with burglary of a habitation and aggravated assault with a deadly weapon.

Everyone has made mistakes they're not proud of. But most people never have to answer for them in public. Even fewer have had their worst moments broadcast for the world to see.
Stanley McChrystal has though. One of our most decorated four-star generals had that moment happen to him. Twice.
I heard him speak at Georgia Tech on Monday about his book, _[On Character: Choices That Define a Life](https://substack.com/redirect/01cf40da-cfef-43ab-bb2a-605b1c2f0ac9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_. If you know his story, you understand why that title carries weight.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0cee66bb-42c0-440e-9d41-e9bbadbeb1a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For those who don't know his background, it's one of the great American stories and unravelings: decorated beyond measure, undone by real failures, and still standing through principled leadership.
McChrystal spent thirty-four years in the U.S. Army and became one of the most consequential military minds of this century. He commanded Joint Special Operations Command (JSOC) -- the most secretive, most lethal force in the American arsenal -- and rebuilt it from scratch, tearing down the walls between the CIA, Delta Force, Rangers, and SEALs and turning a collection of siloed units into a genuine network fast enough to take on an enemy that operated the same way. His team killed Zarqawi. Robert Gates called him "perhaps the finest warrior and leader of men in combat I ever met."
He's a man of valor.
But his record is not without its wrinkles.
In 2004, Army Ranger and former NFL star Pat Tillman was killed by friendly fire in Afghanistan -- shot accidentally by his own men. McChrystal knew within a day. What the public was told was something else entirely. McChrystal personally approved a Silver Star citation describing heroic combat death, signed off on fabricated witness statements, and warned White House speechwriters away from the citation before the truth came out. Tillman's family buried their son believing a lie. They grieved it for weeks before anyone told them the truth.
But his real lapse of judgment came six years later when a _Rolling Stone_ reporter embedded within his inner circle published ["The Runaway General"](https://substack.com/redirect/fd1eafa6-115f-4da4-b1d3-a46bed1719c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- a profile that caught McChrystal's aides mocking then-Vice President Biden and most of the civilian national security leadership. President Obama relieved him of command within days.
One of the greatest military careers of his generation, derailed by a single article.
I was in my second term of Congress when it happened. I remember feeling two things at once -- that civilian control of the military is non-negotiable, full stop, and that one terrible chapter does not cancel what came before it. Both things were true then and both are still true now.
Stan McChrystal is a great American and a dedicated public servant. Accountability and respect aren't opposites. In a functioning system, they have to coexist.
What McChrystal did in the next chapter of his life matters as much as what he did in his military career. He taught leadership at Yale. He chaired a national service organization. He turned down Trump's offer to be Secretary of Defense. Earlier this year he presided over the forced retirement ceremony for five transgender troops pushed out by executive order and called it, publicly, a "[costly mistake](https://substack.com/redirect/65ad3d96-ebd2-4946-975d-5f7a59bde786?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
McChrystal has been speaking for the past year on the lessons of personal character in his book. He doesn't package his mistakes as lessons that conveniently made him better. He sits with them, acknowledging responsibility without making excuses.

* * *
McChrystal built a personal framework for his post-military life around the idea that leadership ultimately comes down to conviction, discipline, and character. Conviction sets the direction. Discipline keeps you moving toward it. But those two together, without the third, can drive you a very long way in the wrong direction.
He created a formula as simple as it is demanding:

**Character = Convictions × Discipline.**
You can have both and still fail the test. He knows that better than most. Convictions are what you believe. Discipline is your ability to actually live by them. Character is what happens -- or doesn't -- at the intersection.
I'd argue it's where the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan ultimately broke down, mainly because we diverted our focus from bringing Osama Bin Laden to justice in Afghanistan, a catastrophic decision, but also through drift - the slow, almost invisible process of objectives being set but never re-examined, assumptions being made and then treated as facts, decisions being stacked on top of flawed premises that nobody stopped to correct. The problem was that nobody owned the responsibility to reassess reality as it changed underneath them.
History is always full of lessons. Take the Battle of Gettysburg which General McCrystal writes eloquently about in his book. There were roughly 50,000 casualties in three days -- not from a single catastrophic mistake, but from a sequence of smaller ones that compounded. Misread terrain, underestimated risk, decisions built on flawed assumptions that nobody interrupted. One bad assumption, on its own, is survivable. A series of them, left alone, is not.
On Monday, he said, "America used to be the land of opportunity. Increasingly it feels like the land of opportunism." When accountability weakens, people stop building institutions and start extracting from them. Short-term incentives crowd out long-term stewardship. And when nobody feels ownership over a system, nobody feels responsible for fixing it when it breaks -- which means by the time the break is visible, it's already compounded into something much harder to correct.
## **The American Pope: A Model of Integrity**
An example of someone showing true character is Pope Leo XIV.
This week, he stood in [Cameroon](https://substack.com/redirect/6c86b37c-73d1-46e2-a2c2-a203cd1ea22e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and said the world is "being ravaged by a handful of tyrants" -- condemning those who "manipulate religion and the very name of God for their own military, economic and political gain, dragging that which is sacred into darkness and filth."
President Trump called Pope Leo "WEAK on Crime" four days earlier. He then shared AI-generated images of himself as a Jesus-like figure. JD Vance piled on. The message from the White House was clear: fall in line, or else.
I was raised and remain Catholic, attending Mass every Sunday. Not because I am perfect, far from it, I am a sinner who falls short but works at it daily. The faith I grew up with didn't promise God was on our side just because we prayed. It asked whether we were on His side - the side of the people most in need - those hungry, those in despair, those who are suffering. What Pope Leo is doing right now isn't a pope straying into politics. It's a man of conscience doing exactly what moral leadership has always required, bearing witness to what's actually happening, regardless of who's made uncomfortable by it.
I'm proud that one of my all-time favorite places - the National Constitution Center in Philadelphia - is awarding America's first-ever Pope - Pope Leo - the National Liberty Medal because of his courage in speaking truth to power and giving hope to so many. Yesterday, a Gallup poll showed 42% of men in the U.S. ages 18-29 said religion is very important to them, as Catholicism has been on the rise since 2000 here in the US.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e3796bdf-343b-4fca-89fe-07614082f688?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **Why National Service Matters**
I've spent years advocating for national service because I believe people who serve -- in uniform, in classrooms, in their communities -- stop seeing themselves as outsiders to the system and start feeling responsible for it. The institutions we take for granted were built by people who showed up and maintained them. They fall apart when nobody does.
That sense of ownership changes behavior. People who serve are more likely to vote, more likely to stay engaged, more likely to hold their leaders accountable -- because they are stakeholders, not spectators. They've been inside the system. They know what it costs to keep it running the right way.
This is not a small thing in a moment like this one. We are watching institutions drift in real time -- toward short-term thinking, toward extraction over stewardship, toward the kind of transactional opportunism that hollows a country out from the inside while the exterior still looks fine.
The antidote to drift is ownership. The antidote to opportunism is service. And the foundation of both -- the thing that makes any of it possible -- is character.
That's what we owe each other.

Ever since my daughter, Ashli Babbitt, was shot by a Capitol Police officer, the Deep State and the fake news media have done nothing but spread lies, slander, and smears about her.

**I 'm writing to you today because I want you to know who my daughter really was, how her rights were trampled over, and how you can help [get justice for Ashli and all the victims of the January 6th political persecution](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4NDl9AAwAAAAAABixSptF_79g-F0n_4yX-3BXTX80riikjkcLhohKTVOtKCG8ltmkvu-pT54veXtGgmPT7_GmmWQjfMzRB1cju9jhoFmPsufCHjBbhM0fNg).**

Ashli was a proud American patriot and veteran who loved God and her family and was passionate about defending our Constitution.

That's why, on January 6, 2021, Ashli went to Washington to exercise her constitutional rights in protest of the certification of the 2020 election results.

**But on that day, a Capitol Hill Police officer shot Ashli in cold blood in a crowded hallway inside the Capitol.**

People have told me it's time to move on, that the forces I am up against are just too big to fight, and that I will never get justice for Ashli.

BUT I WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING! Not just for Ashli but _for _everyone_ who had their rights trampled that day_.

**Many turned their back on those involved with the January 6th protest. However, there is one very special organization that wasn't afraid to fight back. In fact, they are still fighting for justice for January 6th victims and former defendants.**

**That organization is Stand in the Gap.**

[Now, I want to return the favor. Will you support Stand in the Gap's extraordinary mission today?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4NDl9AAwAAAAAABixSptGAH2E6yOj3acxCI_PZZMM6ZHTkkwGFY2aakv1H9gqSpBD-o1NMercqXUJvAR-1CuICEgA1eWQJnOz117MVJjIgCbE2jlzF32WUA)

**Stand in the Gap was founded to _" stand in the gap"_ for the January 6th defendants and their families.**

Now that President Trump has issued pardons for these victims of political persecution, **Stand in the Gap is on a mission to help them navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated.**

|

| | | |
---
Peter,

A recent poll came out showing this race statistically tied. It’s the first poll of the general election, so it’s significant.
North Carolina is our best chance in the country to flip a Republican-held Senate seat, and _far-right PACs were already investing_ millions to defeat me. **Now, with the polls tightening, we can expect an even bigger onslaught of GOP money to come our way.**
**[If you can, please chip in $5 today to help us fight back. I’d appreciate it.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9290?t=8&akid=1082%2E124072%2EOpUbuf)**
The GOP’s attacks are outright lies, which are then being parroted by President Trump and JD Vance. Far-right Republicans are putting millions of dollars behind this misinformation.
I can take an attack ad – I know it’s part of campaigning. I’ve run for statewide office six times (and won all six times). You’re going to have differences of opinion with the other side, and I respect that.
What I can’t respect are the blatant lies that used to be out of bounds but are now becoming part of the norm.
**So that’s led me here today, asking for your help to fight back. I wouldn’t be asking unless it were absolutely necessary.[Will you chip in $5 or more to help me flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9290?t=9&akid=1082%2E124072%2EOpUbuf)**

Roy Cooper

body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1287%2E1086043%2EcR86jw)
This is a longer email about saying goodbye, Peter, but if you don’t have time to read through, I would deeply appreciate **[a contribution to power our campaign.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260417-1.zL4s1-&refcode=em-20260417-1&t=2&akid=1287%2E1086043%2EcR86jw)**
After nearly a century of operation, Valley Forge Military Academy — the place where I went to school and grew from an angry, complicated child to a confident young man — will be closing.
When my mother first sent me to the Forge, she saw military school as a last resort in response to a seemingly endless chain of misbehavior, both at home and at school. At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. **I was not on a path to success.**
There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions — and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets.
After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland _and the first Black governor in the history of my state._
What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me.
**It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success.**
Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement.
I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today.
That includes the **Maryland Corps and Service Year Option** — the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career.
We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. **[If you support that mission, I would appreciate a donation to keep me in the fight as Maryland's governor today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260417-1.zL4s1-&refcode=em-20260417-1&t=3&akid=1287%2E1086043%2EcR86jw)**

At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. I was not on a path to success. There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions — and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets. After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland and the first Black governor in the history of my state. What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me. It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success. Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement. I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today. That includes the Maryland Corps and Service Year Option — the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career. We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. name: Patrick J. Murphy
subject: The Cost of Integrity
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/PJM_Logo.png]
On Character and Accountability
Everyone has made mistakes they're not proud of. But most people never have to answer for them in public. Even fewer have had their worst moments broadcast for the world to see.
Stanley McChrystal has though. One of our most decorated four-star generals had that moment happen to him. Twice.
I heard him speak at Georgia Tech on Monday about his book, On Character: Choices That Define a Life [https://www.amazon.com/dp/0593852958?tag=patrickjmurph-20] . If you know his story, you understand why that title carries weight.
For those who don't know his background, it's one of the great American stories and unravelings: decorated beyond measure, undone by real failures, and still standing through principled leadership.
McChrystal spent thirty-four years in the U.S. Army and became one of the most consequential military minds of this century. He commanded Joint Special Operations Command (JSOC) — the most secretive, most lethal force in the American arsenal — and rebuilt it from scratch, tearing down the walls between the CIA, Delta Force, Rangers, and SEALs and turning a collection of siloed units into a genuine network fast enough to take on an enemy that operated the same way. His team killed Zarqawi. Robert Gates called him "perhaps the finest warrior and leader of men in combat I ever met."
He’s a man of valor.
But his record is not without its wrinkles.
In 2004, Army Ranger and former NFL star Pat Tillman was killed by friendly fire in Afghanistan — shot accidentally by his own men. McChrystal knew within a day. What the public was told was something else entirely. McChrystal personally approved a Silver Star citation describing heroic combat death, signed off on fabricated witness statements, and warned White House speechwriters away from the citation before the truth came out. Tillman's family buried their son believing a lie. They grieved it for weeks before anyone told them the truth.
But his real lapse of judgment came six years later when a Rolling Stone reporter embedded within his inner circle published “The Runaway General” [https://www.rollingstone.com/culture/culture-lists/on-the-ground-with-runaway-general-stanley-mcchrystal-10973/no-title-687-56763/] — a profile that caught McChrystal's aides mocking then-Vice President Biden and most of the civilian national security leadership. President Obama relieved him of command within days.
One of the greatest military careers of his generation, derailed by a single article.
I was in my second term of Congress when it happened. I remember feeling two things at once — that civilian control of the military is non-negotiable, full stop, and that one terrible chapter does not cancel what came before it. Both things were true then and both are still true now.
Stan McChrystal is a great American and a dedicated public servant. Accountability and respect aren’t opposites. In a functioning system, they have to coexist.
What McChrystal did in the next chapter of his life matters as much as what he did in his military career. He taught leadership at Yale. He chaired a national service organization. He turned down Trump's offer to be Secretary of Defense. Earlier this year he presided over the forced retirement ceremony for five transgender troops pushed out by executive order and called it, publicly, a “ costly mistake [https://www.npr.org/2026/02/21/nx-s1-5720178/trump-military-ban-rights-transgender-troops] .”
McChrystal has been speaking for the past year on the lessons of personal character in his book. He doesn't package his mistakes as lessons that conveniently made him better. He sits with them, acknowledging responsibility without making excuses.
***
Character = Convictions × Discipline
McChrystal built a personal framework for his post-military life around the idea that leadership ultimately comes down to conviction, discipline, and character. Conviction sets the direction. Discipline keeps you moving toward it. But those two together, without the third, can drive you a very long way in the wrong direction.
He created a formula as simple as it is demanding:
Character = Convictions × Discipline.
You can have both and still fail the test. He knows that better than most. Convictions are what you believe. Discipline is your ability to actually live by them. Character is what happens — or doesn't — at the intersection.
I’d argue it’s where the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan ultimately broke down, mainly because we diverted our focus from bringing Osama Bin Laden to justice in Afghanistan, a catastrophic decision, but also through drift - the slow, almost invisible process of objectives being set but never re-examined, assumptions being made and then treated as facts, decisions being stacked on top of flawed premises that nobody stopped to correct. The problem was that nobody owned the responsibility to reassess reality as it changed underneath them.
History is always full of lessons. Take the Battle of Gettysburg which General McCrystal writes eloquently about in his book. There were roughly 50,000 casualties in three days — not from a single catastrophic mistake, but from a sequence of smaller ones that compounded. Misread terrain, underestimated risk, decisions built on flawed assumptions that nobody interrupted. One bad assumption, on its own, is survivable. A series of them, left alone, is not.
On Monday, he said, “America used to be the land of opportunity. Increasingly it feels like the land of opportunism.” When accountability weakens, people stop building institutions and start extracting from them. Short-term incentives crowd out long-term stewardship. And when nobody feels ownership over a system, nobody feels responsible for fixing it when it breaks — which means by the time the break is visible, it's already compounded into something much harder to correct.
The American Pope: A Model of Integrity
An example of someone showing true character is Pope Leo XIV.
This week, he stood in Cameroon [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2026/04/16/pope-leo-new-remarks-feud-trump/89639405007/] and said the world is "being ravaged by a handful of tyrants" — condemning those who "manipulate religion and the very name of God for their own military, economic and political gain, dragging that which is sacred into darkness and filth."
President Trump called Pope Leo "WEAK on Crime" four days earlier. He then shared AI-generated images of himself as a Jesus-like figure. JD Vance piled on. The message from the White House was clear: fall in line, or else.
I was raised and remain Catholic, attending Mass every Sunday. Not because I am perfect, far from it, I am a sinner who falls short but works at it daily. The faith I grew up with didn't promise God was on our side just because we prayed. It asked whether we were on His side - the side of the people most in need - those hungry, those in despair, those who are suffering. What Pope Leo is doing right now isn't a pope straying into politics. It's a man of conscience doing exactly what moral leadership has always required, bearing witness to what's actually happening, regardless of who's made uncomfortable by it.
I’m proud that one of my all-time favorite places - the National Constitution Center in Philadelphia - is awarding America’s first-ever Pope - Pope Leo - the National Liberty Medal because of his courage in speaking truth to power and giving hope to so many. Yesterday, Gallup poll showed 42% of men in the U.S. ages 18-29 said religion is very important to them, as Catholicism has been on the rise since 2000 here in the US.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/religious%20men.png]
Why National Service Matters
I've spent years advocating for national service because I believe people who serve — in uniform, in classrooms, in their communities — stop seeing themselves as outsiders to the system and start feeling responsible for it. The institutions we take for granted were built by people who showed up and maintained them. They fall apart when nobody does.
That sense of ownership changes behavior. People who serve are more likely to vote, more likely to stay engaged, more likely to hold their leaders accountable — because they are stakeholders, not spectators. They've been inside the system. They know what it costs to keep it running the right way.
This is not a small thing in a moment like this one. We are watching institutions drift in real time — toward short-term thinking, toward extraction over stewardship, toward the kind of transactional opportunism that hollows a country out from the inside while the exterior still looks fine.
The antidote to drift is ownership. The antidote to opportunism is service. And the foundation of both — the thing that makes any of it possible — is character.
That's what we owe each other.
Order ‘On Character’ here [https://www.amazon.com/dp/0593852958?tag=patrickjmurph-20]
- Patrick

body:
The General Election is a whole different animal.

---
| | | | | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0afb7o1s5ttgh51gl6vf9ft3ru1j0evolttifh8_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c5gm1o74cdh2bs)
---
| | | | | You need to know something about races for Governor:

It's Byron Donalds, President Trump's STRONGEST ally in Florida.

Things are heating up, so I need you to read every single word of this.

When there's no incumbent on the ballot, they don't turn into landslides - They turn into political wars.

**Brutal. Expensive. Close. History doesn 't lie.**

Thanks to the help of MAGA patriots like YOU, so far our message is spreading, and we're in the front.

**But the General Election is a whole different animal.**

Anti-Trump RINOs will team up with the Trump-hating Democrats to flood Florida with seven-figure ad buys, polls will tighten, and the national spotlight will become blinding.

_**[In 2025, Democrats raised $1.8 Billion via ActBlue, and there's no question that they'll top that this year!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5vqo9l3scttnef7oc90nufgjus7bc6k8artu4do_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c5gm1o74cdh2bs "In 2025, Democrats raised $1.8 Billion via ActBlue, and there’s no question that they’ll top that this year!")**_

That's why I can't take these threats lightly.

Because when left-wing Democrats flip a Republican-held Governor's seat, it doesn't just impact one state.

It steers the national conversation against President Trump and all of MAGA.

Lose just one race you're supposed to win, and suddenly the Fake News starts jawing about MAGA being on its last legs.

**And the Democrats know how to keep the narrative alive for as long as humanly possible.**

With you by my side, we won't be intimidated or let it get to that point. If you're able, I'm humbly asking you to chip in today to help me deliver a CRUCIAL victory for MAGA.
---

**It 's bigger, higher profile, and President Trump's home state.**

If Democrats ever manage to flip our Governor's Mansion, they'll declare the entire MAGA Movement DEAD and BURIED!

The truth is, they know they can't win in a fair fight.

That's why they've called upon their liberal media allies to launch MASSIVE smear campaigns against me, my family, and my closest friends.

All just to distract people from their so far left agenda that failed America when Joe Biden was President.

And as America's freest state, Florida needs to continue to be a vanguard for the other 49 states to follow.

**We have an uphill battle ahead, but I know you 're up for the challenge.**

With you by my side, we will deliver ANOTHER victory for MAGA.

Byron Donalds

# **Iran reopens Strait of Hormuz as Lebanon cease-fire holds, sending oil prices tumbling**
President Donald Trump and Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi **[announced Friday that the Strait of Hormuz is now"completely open"](https://substack.com/redirect/dc953a49-2caa-4564-9e78-9285d2e70104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for all commercial vessels "so long as the Israel-Lebanon cease-fire remains in place," which went into effect Friday for 10 days.

* **Trump celebrated on Truth Social** but clarified the US will maintain its naval blockade of Iranian ports specifically--"which does not impede other traffic"--to pressure Tehran into completing peace negotiations, saying "THE NAVAL BLOCKADE WILL REMAIN IN FULL FORCE AND EFFECT AS IT PERTAINS TO IRAN, ONLY, UNTIL SUCH TIME AS OUR TRANSACTION WITH IRAN IS 100% COMPLETE."

* **Oil prices plummet** : Crude oil prices dropped from $92.48 per barrel Tuesday to roughly $83 per barrel following the announcement. Trump said "MOST OF THE POINTS ARE ALREADY NEGOTIATED" and "THIS PROCESS SHOULD GO VERY QUICKLY."
* **What 's next**: The cease-fire between Israel and Lebanon is scheduled to last 10 days and set the stage for US-Iran peace talks set to expire Tuesday. Iran had initially claimed Lebanon was included in the US-Iran cease-fire, but Washington held firm that Israel's battle with Hezbollah was not part of the original deal.

HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.**[got into a shouting match with Rep. Terri Sewell](https://substack.com/redirect/38dce480-88c5-4d42-a89c-2504ef2391af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during a Thursday budget hearing after she confronted him about 2024 podcast remarks alleging "every Black kid is now just standardly put on Adderall, SSRIs, benzos" and needs to be "reparented" at his proposed rural "rehabilitation facilities" modeled after "wellness farms" with "no cellphones, no screens."
Kennedy denied every saying such a think and demanded Sewell "play the recording," which she could not provide.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/38dce480-88c5-4d42-a89c-2504ef2391af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Kennedy made the original comments on the "Earn Your Leisure" podcast while running for president in 2024, discussing plans to fight the drug epidemic.

Chris Ostroushko told podcast host Brian Shapiro **[his family are"absolutely not violent people"](https://substack.com/redirect/6582f97b-2f7f-465b-88bc-b8d77eee1270?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and were defending themselves during an April 11 anti-ICE protest outside Minnesota's Whipple building, where viral video shows him shoving TPUSA reporter Savanah Hernandez to the ground. | | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
April 17, 2026
**LETLOW CALLS OUT CASSIDY FOR MISLEADING VOTERS ON TRUMP SUPPORT**
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — A new [report](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=ded33c2943&e=95355a072c) from Fox News highlights how Bill Cassidy, despite voting to convict President Trump and attacking him for five years, is trying to deceive voters by running television advertisements tying himself to President Trump and the America First Agenda. Meanwhile, Julia Letlow has President Trump’s complete and total endorsement.
**Snubbed by Trump, GOP candidates fighting for re-election act like they have his backing anyway** _Sen Bill Cassidy and Rep Thomas Massie feature Trump in campaign spots without mentioning his endorsement of their rivals_
In two high-profile cases this year, incumbents fighting for their political lives are trying to make it appear the president is supporting them anyway.
Sen. Bill Cassidy of Louisiana is facing primary challenges from two Republicans in next month's primary: Rep. Julia Letlow and former Rep. John Fleming, who is currently the state treasurer. Trump earlier this year weighed into the race by endorsing Letlow.
Cassidy was one of only seven Senate Republicans who voted in early 2021 to convict Trump after he was impeached by the House for his role in the violent Jan. 6 attack on the U.S. Capitol by supporters who aimed to upend congressional certification of former President Joe Biden's 2020 election victory. Trump was acquitted by the Senate.
In his first campaign commercial after Trump endorsed Letlow, Cassidy, a doctor, highlighted a bill he authored that passed into law and increases penalties for criminals convicted of manufacturing and distributing fentanyl.
"President Trump said it was the most important legislation he would sign this year," the senator said in the spot under pictures of Trump.
In another spot, the narrator highlights that "Cassidy worked with President Trump to pass tax cuts," under pictures of the president and the senator and the words "Trump & Cassidy" repeatedly flashing on the screen.

body:
From cutting costs to bringing businesses, Maryland doesn’t play for second
---
| | | | | [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2FPages%2Fhome.aspx/1/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/2xDnXXjoJbipxAHKfE8BFYv9MreGH9C_5nY1vX6kXDg=452)
---
| | [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv=eZK5QuvXcQs/1/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/Ucwk-m0IFDYCgoy6HtlJ9INQcRHzySYK-OUwbwPPoo0=452)
---
My fellow Marylanders,
Over the last 90 days, we watched chaos unfold in Washington, D.C. But let there be no question: In Maryland, we don’t just push back, we push forward.
At a time when Washington can’t find common ground on common-sense issues, **97%** of the bills we’ve introduced and gotten passed since our administration came on board have passed with bipartisan support.
At a time when Marylanders are getting crushed by skyrocketing costs, **we passed bills to address the cost of utilities, housing, child care, and groceries.**
At a time when the President is tearing apart the Department of Education, **Maryland is delivering a record $10.1** **billion** for K-12 education.
At a time when Maryland’s federal workforce has declined by 31,100 jobs – jobs that included people who keep our communities safe – **in Maryland, we’ve delivered record funding support for local law enforcement, with the state seeing one of the greatest drops in violent crime in the country over the past three years.**
Our administration laid out three core objectives in January:
* Making life more affordable for the people of Maryland,
* Protecting the people of Maryland from Washington’s cuts and chaos, and
* Making Maryland more economically competitive.

Meeting these goals required all of us working together, including the Marylanders who traveled to Annapolis over these past 90 days to make their voices heard. This was a successful session for the people of Maryland, and I’m grateful for our partners in this work – **including you.**
Your Governor,
Wes Moore
P.S. [You can learn more about our successful legislative agenda aimed at protecting our people, making Maryland more affordable, and increasing the state's economic competitiveness here.](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Celebrates-Passage-of-Entire-2026-Legislative-Agenda,-Delivering-on-Commitment-to-Protect-Marylanders,-Lower.aspx/1/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/IAOXI7OB_yjOFYQPIw6-wo3TvB-uV8PAExWJKq-Axew=452)
| | [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2FPages%2Fhome.aspx/2/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/Bpj_3iK3jZ1phpBVMtrBWykLkxlcevI78FErFvpCK44=452)
---
### **[UPDATE: Court Ruling on Proposed ICE Facility](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Statement-on-Court-Ruling-on-Proposed-ICE-Facility-in-Washington-County.aspx/1/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/YFCcu_tUO6X5o_9wtlP146FyU0HnNuRNc2na0_8Gnck=452)**
### **[in Washington County](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Statement-on-Court-Ruling-on-Proposed-ICE-Facility-in-Washington-County.aspx/2/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/ZLzIIVUad2WhyH4CXOKooJieOl3NB0uo4CG3kGbSqcQ=452)

**
This week, a federal court **granted a preliminary injunction halting construction** on the proposed ICE Facility in Washington County.
This ruling is a major and welcome step forward. We’ve been clear from the start: this project raises grave concerns for Washington County — from environmental damage, to water and sewer capacity, to emergency services, to the loss of economic opportunity, to the broader lack of transparency around this process. Those concerns deserve to be fully heard before irreversible construction moves ahead.
My administration will keep working with Attorney General Brown, local leaders, and Maryland’s federal congressional delegation to ensure full compliance with the law and to protect the well-being of Marylanders.

Samsung Biologics just opened their very FIRST U.S.-based manufacturing facility right here in Maryland! Life-saving therapies for people around the world are going to be made here in America, while also strengthening our state’s economy.
Maryland delivers – and we’re not playing for second.

### [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-celebrates-the-formation-of-the-enough-alliance-and-100-million-dollar-philanthropic-investment-to-end-child.aspx/1/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/6nGaMM0I2EyT6PWjiLV5QuvnAycd2alsZ26j4zzH4Ns=452)[](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2FpJIZroxGskY/1/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/ctizY6ffQtS1d7PjezymwJg5msuJ8UUD2bwQc--KDJ8=452)[Here’s Our Transit-Oriented Development Plan:](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv=KIp6bzhlVA4/2/0100019d9beb1de0-d7abe655-2219-4c5d-8495-3e6c0bef1c3e-000000/YlKHuPxZJER8sifouB4mhC_doKEByxjoRySlS09y-2o=452)
