[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LtqwzAUxvGnkbcYXY_sQUNp8JaQkkJHc6JLIirHRpJj-vbFfYTO38dv-H-dxhPGFJ_3M07e5BpGN7ux5nVanLcJsy-vaOucf-IzZhw55XCg8sD0uOS5LN7WkTXOOOuQ2cYbpjVI0FrS5mEo-lsAVFKHHqjvgQflQHHoUIHudRPNDlLJNBdMia5VWoXQKQRHe-G6nkiKyefaZr-stxQtPiuW7zBn61s7T00yj1qXQsQb4QPhw7Zt7X09eDtP-074wI_yAl1_JXwQXH6cr_uNiKGsN0bE8fPy3mTjli2mFAtoIul9wpj-9PrvJC_DfwMAAP__eg5wGg)
The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with
Republican Task Force Issue: 4/17/2026

Iran's Hormuz Gambit

Iran declared the Strait of Hormuz "completely open" for commercial vessels on Friday--but President Trump said the [U.S. naval blockade on Iranian ships and ports will remain in full force](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLvO4yAUhJ_G7oi4GLALim3SZdstrWMuyVEwRgecaPfpV8kj_OVopNF835_begPMWO6_YY-OelrDEdZO515D9Bkothf6ftBfLEiwSi4N4xMTdq10tBp9X8UYXPABhB-jE9aayVg78fHhZuGD0EGYwPWWlLRpUZYntSQ5y9nHEd1nkE_CSiW0mi_a6pRmDSbwRYV5GSYOOVK_UKznltFD6dCe6SAfL_7Yx-wevdc2qF-DvA7yCrXEd_tUn0AdfY6DvJ6NIUFhbyCW4wblKAwbQcysQ342VuGJrUNhj4P28x8TlkElzOxLPG1Bg1wgGT5HvwUrlTZaL5vyWgdjR3KhvjFnbMYOE7_vgPn7r_9Y6svJ_wEAAP__HCGIyg) until Tehran reaches a deal--including on its nuclear program. A 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon brokered by the U.S. went into effect Thursday at 5 p.m. Eastern. Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi said passage through the strait is open "for the remaining period of ceasefire," [a framing that puts a time limit](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O5CAQhJ8GZ1iAf_AGBJc420svtNrQ7LQOG9Tgsfae_jTzCBtVUFKpvu_P5_YJlOj8-g0HOm5xCzlsja-jBPQJGOuTfMv8TScxbEaZWapRarsVzrWgb5vuggs-gPYdOm3tPM7Wjqp7uAXQ2BCtWZZ9GqKJu9avUBH3ZTJTR-41qEZtzaCnYeknO8W4TDAH9TGE5UOMChJy6xnLtSfycDaof2Nmj73PR5fco7VSxfBLmFWY9b7v3u_1xLu-emHWRE-UVwnQsAqzEsMpb2B5VfnmlLUxUJM5ykfm4_onA5WUD_Df0iNUjMQozNqxC-WmlKjOVozq6wBK7w_tx-KezvwPAAD__3lCg0U) on any maritime relief. Trump hinted at new peace talks with Iran on Friday, predicting the war "should be ending pretty soon." Oil and gas prices fell sharply on the news. Gen. Dan Caine, chairman of the Joint Chiefs, said the U.S. will ["use force" on any noncompliant ships](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFuwyAURb8Gb44AY4gHhi7e0rWj9QKP5KnYRg-SqH9fOf2Dzlc6V-d8XZYLUKbt9gkrem5piXtcGj_WEjFkYKxPCm3nH9qIYdFS216aXrml8F4LhraoLvoYIqjQoVfOWWOdM7K7-4CTuwZlA1qwJk2gLMSrTGYAo61yHfkDKI1yelDjcD6NbkzpPIKNchrieRJGQkZuJ8byuGYKsDWo32nngKewr13299ZKFcOH0LPQM5QNX_WYhJ4zPVHomRi2_gXcU2XA3L_1_iz6479jH8uLcqZqnTDytgLlN739O8nT698AAAD__xtTcwo) in the blockade zone. ★★★
FISA Rebellion

House Republicans staged an overnight revolt against their own leadership's push for an 18-month renewal of Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA)--the government's most powerful warrantless surveillance authority. A bloc of roughly 20 libertarian-leaning Republicans [derailed both a five-year and an 18-month renewal](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LuO6yAUheGnwZ0tbgZcUJzGXU47pbXDJdkabBCQOPP2o0wz_dRL-pb0f1y2C2DC4_Yf9mBrj5vPfuv1sRcfXIIa2hNdz_ULD6ywccrVSOXI9FZqbiW4vrHBW-88MDcEy7RWUmkt6XC3EL3xLEhphFzoooyk6uq1MCJKSiMMaN8glUxzwWZhplnPMZoZlKeL8GYhkkIKtU81lMc1oYOjQ_uMubowubwPyd57L42If4SvhK_neU7wwtzeK-Hr2yd8pZLwlWnC13t-tDD-cm0s0NoYscEYXj0cDfMxVOvLiSlhU5pIetsB089f_3Okp-XfAQAA__-J4Hj3) that Trump had demanded--forcing Speaker Mike Johnson into an embarrassing retreat. The House ultimately passed a 10-day extension by unanimous consent in the early morning hours. The Senate quickly ratified the stopgap, buying Congress until April 30. Republicans are now [blaming the White House](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGu4yAQAL_G7rAA2-BXUFzj7l17pbWBdbI6DAjWcfL3p9wnvHqk0Wj-fG_fQJHS_Tcc6CrvW8hh43oeJaCPULE9yXOub0pUYdNSGyEnoexWam4FPW-qDy74AMr36JS1ZjLWTrJ_uHn3cpH-FsDIMchgVLBGWlQe0NsFe3IfoZyU1aOax2WY7bzvywwmyK8xLF_dJCFi5aFiOW-RPCSG9nfP1ePg89FH92AurRt_dXrt9Hpd17DnV8KrfXin15IjMfnW6bVhAkbBeJRcoVJ8C3wxptBEAqacmvA5cc1PrI0gilbelO6i5AtrE498NhT7edwitr66UC6KkZqx3STvB1D8n8Q__vh0-l8AAAD__7Cdixc) for the chaotic rollout of a surveillance fight that was months in the making. ★★★
DHS Shutdown Grinds On

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) shutdown crossed 60 days Thursday--surpassing the previous record--with no resolution in sight as Congress remains deadlocked on funding. Officials are warning of accelerating damage: the Coast Guard faces unpaid utility bills, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) has grounded aircraft, and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has a [growing vacuum in cyber planning activities](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL8O2yAQh58Gb0QYY5MMDF28pWtH68IdNgoG68Cx-vZVOvQBuv_-fPp-PZcnxBTz-hN2ctzCggWXxud-IPkETPUTfSv8O-bIsGilJ6mM7O1ycKkH-bb0HTr0CL3vyPXWTmay1qhuc2iIgvUP31szGWXRWx1IA47jiMqHLrrvoDK91UM_DvfbaMcQ7iNMqB4D3h_CKEjE7cZ0nK8UPeQG9R0Ke7r5snfJba0dVQw_hJ6FngMhMaRMV83UrsLvb0zoeS0f4rxTbrJuZ8NyZaHn773QszJCz7hVWUKIPkKq8gLOEl7lbHLlcsW8_uvJF_h3KmsVeu7Y4XHFlGKdrDBq3SGmv2Ttv3V-nP4TAAD__y0TitQ). name: Deb Haaland
subject: Can I share something personal with you?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=em-header%3Frefcode%3Djtk579-su-nd&t=1&akid=9050%2E400544%2EuauZcp)
---
Hey, friend, it's Deb. This isn't a typical fundraising email — I want to share something personal with you:**I _love_ to cook.**

My passion for New Mexican cuisine started early, thanks to the hours I spent watching my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She wouldn’t let us kids in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours. I still hold those memories close as I prepare my favorite traditional New Mexican dishes.
[](http://act.debhaaland.com/go/8014?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&%3Bzip=&%3Bcode=jtk579-su-nd&t=2&akid=9050%2E400544%2EuauZcp)
**There’s something powerful about connecting with others over a home-cooked meal.[ So today, as a special thank you for being a part of my team, I'm sharing one of my favorite recipes: green chile chicken posole. I hope you can enjoy it with someone special in your life.](http://act.debhaaland.com/go/8015?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&code=jtk579-su-nd&t=3&akid=9050%2E400544%2EuauZcp)**
Cooking became more than a hobby after I decided to start my own salsa business. I worked out of a commercial kitchen and bought my red chile pequin from a farm in northern New Mexico. I’d prepare my salsa and deliver jars to mom-and-pop shops across the state, often with my child riding with me in the back seat.
[](http://act.debhaaland.com/go/8014?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&%3Bzip=&%3Bcode=jtk579-su-nd&t=4&akid=9050%2E400544%2EuauZcp)
For me, cooking has always been a way to foster connection and build community, which is exactly what we’re doing as we grow this campaign across New Mexico. I’ve had the chance to sit down with people in living rooms and around kitchen tables to hear about their lives, their struggles, and their hopes for the future. Those conversations are a reminder of just how high the stakes are in this race and why I’m in it.

And while others in this race try to cast doubt, I know my lived experience is exactly what New Mexicans need, and it’s why I fight for it.

As a small-business owner, I know we can make it easier for you to start a business, which is why I will create a one-stop shop for small businesses, because turning your passion into a livelihood should not be so hard in New Mexico. As a single mother, I know how much universal childcare matters; I will protect and expand it. I have struggled to make ends meet, so I know firsthand that New Mexicans need a raise. I took on Donald Trump to protect healthcare, so I know how to push back when his policies hurt New Mexicans. As Secretary of the Interior, I led a 70,000-person workforce and an $18 billion budget and delivered real results. I have been tested, I have delivered, and I am ready to lead on day one.
**[I'm forever grateful for the support I've gotten from this grassroots community, which is why I'm sharing one of my favorite recipes with you today. We've still got a long road ahead, so fuel up with a pot of posole and get ready! With good food and good friends, we can do anything.](http://act.debhaaland.com/go/8015?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&code=jtk579-su-nd&t=5&akid=9050%2E400544%2EuauZcp)**
| | [🌶️ Deb's Green Chile Chicken Posole Recipe 🌶️](http://act.debhaaland.com/go/8014?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&%3Bzip=&%3Bcode=jtk579-su-nd&t=6&akid=9050%2E400544%2EuauZcp)
---
Happy cooking!

Deb 🌶️
|
* * *
| | [Donate >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1101?refcode=jtk579-su-nd&t=7&akid=9050%2E400544%2EuauZcp)
